messages:
Ada: Short postmortem from today's handoff test: non-resident forwards caused p95 spike and legal flagged potential data residency violation.
Mike: Quick question: was proxy using a control-plane lookup or cached tenant config when it forwarded?
Ada: Cached config. We saw `kv_cache=MISS` and then forward. No consent header present.
Sara: Proposal: default deny for region-restricted tenants. Control-plane exposes tenant flag `allow_forwarding` default=false. Proxies honor cached flag (no sync hot path).
Leo: For client ergonomics, support `X-Region-Consent: eu-west` for explicit client opt-in. Also emit `X-Fallback-Region: eu-west` when we deny so SDKs can reconnect.
Mike: Runtime defaults: tenant_cache_ttl=10s, soft_forward_window=8s after ownership flip, require 2 heartbeats before committing swap. On cache miss proxy returns `503` + `X-Fallback-Region`.
Ada: Ops playbook sketch: prewarm cache before planned cutovers, force-refresh endpoint for tenants, mark tenant `resident-only` if probes fail, alert when `handoff.forward_denied_rate > 5%` for 2m.
Sara: Compliance needs: who can toggle `allow_forwarding`, audit retention policy, tenant-scoped KMS for forward audits, and tests to block analytics exports from forwarded payloads.
Dev Bot: controlplane: swap_event=3959990025 probes_ok=36 probes_fail=4
Ada: Action items: Mike will draft RFC with header proto + proxy pseudocode + metrics; Sara will prepare compliance bullets; Leo will sketch SDK fallback callback.
